% Sole normative requirements: full authoritative statements, not crosswalk summaries.
\newcommand{\Req}[3]{\par\medskip\textbf{SCI-FRUIT-REQ-#1: #2}\par#3\par}


\newcommand{\NormRequirements}{%
\Unit{Normative requirements 1--5}{core:req1}{%
\Req{001}{Authority separation}{The scientific authority record shall distinguish approved program-order authority A, approved conditional-composition authority B and unavailable numerical-method authority C. Neither authorship, verification, consistency review nor conditional freeze shall imply numerical approval. Every numerical instance shall have an exact FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD/<method-name>@<revision> identity, complete scientific record, separate Grant Wilson approval and required upstream authority. Missing approval shall retain \NA\ for every dependent numerical route and result.}
\Req{002}{Typed objects and spaces}{Every scientific object shall bind quantity, units/scale, frame/domain, grid/sampling, shape/axes/indexing, timing where relevant, grouping, support, validity/missing/non-finite causes, parent/producer and generations. The input, residual, processed residual, projected removal, rejoin, result, target, state and each model role shall be separately typed. Shape, coordinate, filename or label agreement shall not substitute for scientific identity. All declared map domains and codomains shall be compatible with their actual operands and output role.}
\Req{003}{Candidate, accepted and applied models}{Candidate, accepted and applied models shall have separately bound objects, spaces, supports, origin/prior, construction/selection/acceptance/application rules and generations. Every intervening transformation and its allowed inputs shall be exact, including normalization, clipping, sign, projection, restriction and unit conversion where used. Equality of roles or any property requires an exact method/state fact. Removal and rejoin shall consume the applied model. Acceptance grants feedback-model state only, not truth, detection, posterior or downstream fitness.}
\Req{004}{Additive compatibility}{Removal and rejoin shall each bind compatible quantity, units/scale, frame/domain, grid/sampling, support, additive origin/reference or gauge, null-space state, calibration and response conventions. Spaces shall be exact additive spaces or explicitly declared affine/quotient spaces with well-defined coordinate/quotient arithmetic and one reference/gauge per operation. Every alignment/conversion shall be explicit. Incompatible or missing facts shall make the affected arithmetic and dependent claim unavailable; arbitrary representatives, implicit offsets and inferred equality of input/output spaces are forbidden.}
\Req{005}{Exact conditional composition}{A method shall bind the exact $\Pi_k:M_k^{\ap}\to Y_k$, $F_k:Y_k\to Z_k$ and $B_k:M_k^{\ap}\to Z_k$, sign, support/state and operation graph for $\rho_k=\yin-\Pi_k(\ma)$ and $z_k=F_k(\rho_k)+B_k(\ma)$. Each path contribution shall be available or exactly reconstructible on claimed support. Equal projection/rejoin, inverse maps, equal domains, universal bypass or unknown-as-zero shall not be assumed. Missing required contributions shall block the affected numerical composition.}
}
\Unit{Normative requirements 6--10}{core:req2}{%
\Req{006}{Linearity hierarchy and derivative premises}{Distributive expansion shall require the complete residual procedure $F_k=A_k$ fixed linear on the exact domain/support/state. Defining the linear model-path operator $D_k=B_k-A_k\circ\Pi_k$ shall additionally require fixed linear projection and rejoin on compatible spaces. Affine offsets shall remain. Otherwise the full composition shall be used. General fixed-state derivatives shall require differentiability on exact compatible tangent/reference/gauge spaces with bound baseline, units/basis, support, codomain, convention and fixed conditioning; complete fixed linearity then reduces them to $A_k,D_k$.}
\Req{007}{Parent route, grouping and iteration input}{Every iteration shall retain immutable original measured-parent ancestry and bind one exact available producer route and complete grouping, membership, axes and scope. The route shall supply quantity, units, frame, response, beam/template, calibration, support, validity, lifecycle and provenance. The method shall declare the iteration-input rule and all domain conversions. Original-parent, prior-result and reconstruction routes are distinct methods; no recurrence follows from the word iteration. Shared parent/model/calibration/reference dependence shall remain explicit; grouping/coaddition shall not imply commutation.}
\Req{008}{Eight support and influence roles}{Every iteration shall expose separately addressable measured-parent support, model-definition support for each model stage, projection/removal support, residual-processing support per operation, model-rejoin support, final-output support, learning influence and response-query support. Each shall bind its exact scientific query, domain, operation/path/application, parents/generation, value or permitted typed status and cause. A common mask or shape shall not substitute for distinct roles. No method shall waive a role; exact reconstruction is permitted only with a bound reconstruction and failure contract.}
\Req{009}{Occurrence classes and mode origin}{Composition shall distinguish residual-and-model-supported, residual-only, model-only and unavailable occurrences under exact method permissions and pairwise compatibility. Absent contributions shall not become numerical zero. Undefined unequal-support behavior shall be unavailable; no implicit fill, extrapolation, renormalization or gauge repair is permitted. Model/prior content in an unavailable measured mode shall retain model-or-prior-supported origin, separately from occurrence class, with response/uncertainty consequences. Iteration, learning, projection and rejoin shall create neither acquired exposure nor independent observations nor recovered measured modes.}
\Req{010}{Method rules and realized state}{Changes to parent route/grouping, learning/construction or operator-defining resolution rule, operator family, sign/order/bypass graph, support, recurrence, stopping, terminal selector or failure behavior shall create a new method identity. Changed operator-defining coefficients, models or state under unchanged resolution rules shall have distinct state/iteration/application generations; internal fixed-map coordinates may change without a new operator generation. Method, state, absolute iteration, application, attempt, branch, lineage and product generations shall remain distinct. Requested/effective/resolved/realized facts shall not be conflated; representation changes alone shall not imply changed scientific state.}
}
\Unit{Normative requirements 11--14}{core:req3}{%
\Req{011}{Operation graph and operator-defining state}{Every named operation and consequential component shall bind owner, parents/generations, inputs, ordered location, path, count and failure scope. Retain all seven operation-state categories at exact conditioning scopes. Distinguish operator-defining state/coefficients, internal fixed-map application coordinates and a frozen removed component. Fixed structural state with recomputed operator-defining coefficients shall bind its resolution rule, dependencies, schedule and realized map; relearning binds population/triggers. A changed internal coordinate alone shall imply no relearning, re-resolution, method change, operator generation or RF-03. Factor mixed stages; bind bypass locations/counts on both paths. No fixed-state label alone proves linearity.}
\Req{012}{Exact fixed-map local response queries}{RF-01 shall perturb only iteration input while freezing complete realized operator-defining state and induced numerical $\Pi_k,F_k,B_k$ maps, applied model and other fixed facts. RF-02 shall perturb only the applied model under the same fixed-map condition with measured input fixed. Each shall evaluate required internal coordinates of those maps on its perturbed operand; their changed values alone do not change the map or RF role. Bind source/tangent domains, units/basis, baseline, codomain and convention. The admitted PTC specialization has fixed $P^{\rm PTC}_{g,t,\Theta}$ and derivative $H P^{\rm PTC}_{g,t,\Theta}$ on its exact domain, retaining fixed affine centering. Insufficient source/state or finite/rank/support-domain failure yields typed unavailability or a separately typed transition, never silent RF-03 identity.}
\Req{013}{Procedure and composed response scopes}{RF-03 shall rerun all unchanged-method operations that can change operator-defining map or consequential state within one iteration: model construction/acceptance, loading, metric, support/mask, centering/reference, rank, grouping, selection, threshold, branch or other state resolution. Prior iteration state and upstream procedure/state remain fixed. Evaluation of a fixed-map internal coordinate alone is not such a rerun. RF-04 propagates exact fixed-sequence/index dependence; RF-05 includes stopping/resources and terminal selection; RF-06 reruns included upstream producers; RF-07 holds upstream procedure/state/generation fixed and composes the parent-domain entry and FRUIT-only extent with RF-03/04/05 references. Bind causal scope, domains, generations and comparison. Fixed derivatives shall not substitute for procedure queries; unavailable comparisons retain typed causes/transitions.}
\Req{014}{Law-relative stochastic targets}{Every stochastic target shall bind exact law identity, random variables, conditioned fixed objects, resolution/selection condition, omitted variation, support/domain and reference/gauge/null-space state. Pre-outcome shall mean before that law's random event. Physical/random-parent targets shall retain random parent/model values; explicitly fixed-realized-model targets omit model-learning variation and have zero model/cross blocks only there. Conditional NOI-randomization targets may fix realized parent/model/operator/support and exact source-law design-resolution conditions; they are not physical-parent targets. FRUIT branch/completion/convergence/terminal-conditioned targets need separate method and estimand authority. Under complete fixed linearity and finite compatible joint moments, all four law-qualified covariance terms shall remain unless exact law/conditioning authorizes omission.}
}
\Unit{Normative requirements 15--18}{core:req4}{%
\Req{015}{Core-declared uncertainty, mismatch, transfer, shift and bias}{All core-declared uncertainty roles shall remain separately addressable with exact law, random/fixed/resolution facts, domain, units, availability/cause, generation and omissions. Candidate, selection, accepted, transformation, applied and parent/applied cross roles shall remain distinct from other core-declared sources; exact NOI-owned product binding shall not be invented. Accepted covariance/error shall reach applied space only through exact transformation and dependence. $D_k$ shall be MODEL-PATH-TRANSFER; $D_k\delta m_k^{\ap}$ MODEL-INDUCED-OUTPUT-SHIFT. MODEL-MISMATCH and MODEL-INDUCED-BIAS shall have separate identities outside the uncertainty family. Bias requires estimand, reference/truth model, error random variable, law and conditioning; otherwise it is unavailable even when transfer/shift exist. Deterministic difference is not covariance.}
\Req{016}{NOI law, member action and source parity}{Every FRUIT-to-NOI member shall bind iteration, member, target law, parent/output domains, ensemble generation, center convention and exact source authority or typed unavailable external binding. Under complete fixed linearity with fixed applied model/state, full parents shall produce $A_k y_{k,b}^{\mathrm{full}}+D_k\ma$ and their exact law-qualified center; zero-target-law members shall produce $A_k\delta y_{k,b}^{\mathrm{NOI}}$ without rejoin. Zero means expectation under the exact conditional NOI law, not member/spatial/finite-ensemble mean subtraction or $B-1$ correction; individual source/residual structure may remain. Full-affine methods need separate center/estimator authority, source-law, response/support parity and method identity. Fixed-state, dependent-successor and relearned methods/ensembles shall remain distinct and admit no numerical route here.}
\Req{017}{Continuation and attempt lineage}{After completion of absolute zero-based iteration $N$, exact continuation shall start at $N+1$ from $S_{N+1}$ and agree with uninterrupted execution under the same future controls and compatible method/numerical profile. It shall preserve every future-consequential scientific/stochastic/control fact or exact reconstruction with failure behavior; a result array alone is insufficient. Restart shall create a new lineage with reused ancestry explicit. Branch, successor and retry shall retain exact parent state, attempts, randomness and failure accounting. No reset, independent observation or sufficiency follows merely from saved state or a successful replay process exit.}
\Req{018}{Product handoff and branched lifecycle}{Each immutable request generation shall have request\_state not\_requested or requested; a later request creates a new generation, not an in-place transition. For requested generations, preserve the exact successful producer-stage order and distinct effective/resolved/applied/realized/candidate/decision/completed/published meanings. Scientific availability and producer outcome shall be separately typed at the stage actually reached, with cause/scope/generation; early stop shall fabricate no later invocation, realization, completion or publication. Supersession shall preserve prior records. Exact product declarations, parents and bundle bindings are mandatory: ITERATION-RESULT is a child payload whose scientific consumption requires its exact ITERATION-BUNDLE or immutable reference. Terminal selection shall create a separate immutable record over completed iterations.}
}
\Unit{Normative requirements 19--21}{core:req5}{%
\Req{019}{Completion, convergence and stopping}{Iteration completeness, resource exhaustion, convergence, policy stop, failure, terminal selection and consumer fitness shall be distinct claims. A convergence proposition shall bind quantity/domain, metric/norm, scale/denominator, tolerance, direction, persistence/consecutive rule, missing/non-finite behavior, generation and state. Resource limits shall bind exact accounting/counters and consequences. Completion or a reached limit shall not imply convergence; convergence shall not imply correctness, unit response, unbiasedness or adequacy. The conditional core shall select no convergence test, tolerance, limit, stopping rule or fitness policy.}
\Req{020}{Comparable terminal selection and open-world use}{Selection shall use one exact predeclared rule over completed candidates with data access, ties/failure and all nine terminal fields. Candidates shall share or undergo exact selector-owned conversion into common quantity/role, units/scale, frame/grid/domain, reference/gauge, response, support, method/generation and uncertainty/metric meaning. All cross-route/method/grouping/gauge/generation/support conversions belong to selector identity. Retain every candidate, inclusion/exclusion, conversion, tie, unavailable comparison/cause and terminal response/uncertainty. Field 9 shall hold only requested/linked downstream decision identities and exact statuses, or an explicit no-request statement; no closed-world future-use list is required. Equal shape/scalar or last/latest/lowest-residual/visual preference shall not imply selection.}
\Req{021}{Universal bundle and role-local hard dependencies}{Base iteration/terminal completion shall require all universal and exact method-required roles with values/reconstruction or core-and-method-permitted statuses. No method shall waive core roles or hard dependencies for result, continuation, response/uncertainty or selection. Unknown remains unavailable, never zero/identity/bypass/omission. An unavailable optional companion permits only a narrower product allowed by both core and method. The exact FRUIT-owned decision establishes completion and immutable publication. Downstream use shall not participate in base completion; only an exact explicitly requested FRUIT product role may require a specified child, with that dependency restricted to that requested role. A bare result payload shall not replace its bundle.}
}
\Unit{Normative requirements 22--24}{core:req6}{%
\Req{022}{Producer ownership and SCI-VAL-congruent child records}{FRUIT shall preserve exact producer quantity/calibration/response/support/admission and source authority while owning model/update/recurrence, stopping, local completion, selector and publication. Downstream use shall be an immutable child reference, never a parent mutation or new FRUIT iteration. For SCI-VAL-governed use, retain exact request, applicability, eligibility and realization states plus profile/source binding. Not-requested creates no eligibility proposition. Missing profile/unresolved scope may yield a realized accounting record with applicability\_unknown and decision\_unavailable; generic unavailable shall not be a SCI-VAL realization value. Incomplete/failed/not-produced artifacts are separate realization conditions. SCI-VAL may evaluate an exact approved use policy but shall not execute FRUIT, advance recurrence or select model/terminal.}
\Req{023}{Complete method-record gate}{Every method-specific instance shall bind all twenty-one required classes: authority/lineage; route/grouping; input rule; target/model; construction/selection/acceptance/application; accumulation meaning; typed composition; additive/unavailable modes; operation graph; state by operation; support/missing data; update/transition; response; uncertainty; continuation; stochastic state; convergence; resources; terminal selection; persistence/reconstruction; completion/failure/publication. Each shall satisfy the complete scientific obligations of this core, including corrected fixed-map/defining-state-rerun responses, closed uncertainty-role grammar and law-relative NOI member meaning, terminal conversions, open-world linked use, request/producer branches and universal dependencies. Actual values, owner approval and required upstream authority are mandatory for numerical admission; filled fields alone do not pass the gate.}
\Req{024}{Predictions, missing premises and claim ceilings}{This complete sole current r0.3 review-candidate normative core supersedes r0.2 as the review candidate; it is not owner approved, frozen or activated. No unstated historical sentence supplies a current obligation. The method and claim shall preserve all six stable assumptions and twenty conditional predictions, with their exact premises, consequences and missing-premise behavior. Missing authority or premises shall block only the affected claim, with typed status, cause, scope and provenance; they shall not be repaired by an invented algorithm, default or evidence. Document verification shall not claim numerical conformance, fidelity, coverage, recovered modes, convergence adequacy, downstream fitness, observational validation, performance, readiness, production suitability/authorization or Unity activity. Numerical development, qualification and policy recommendations retain separate owner decisions and independent-pointing evidence obligations.}
}
}
